transport: One JSON input file and writable resource directory as two CLI arguments. One JSON output object with results in operation order.
obligations: Input image bytes are authoritative. Different documents and repeated names never alias mutable storage.
Active document IDs are unique; duplicate extraction returns document_exists without modifying the active document.
Reads return original bytes in image order. Missing or released document reads return document_missing.
S0 inline bytes; S1 onward file references have null inline bytes and unique paths under the supplied resource directory.
S2 batch returns one extraction result per document. A document exceeding cap fails byte_cap atomically before storing any resource, without undoing other successful documents.
The cap counts decoded bytes, not base64 characters, and accepts equality. Retry after a rejected document is allowed.
S3 release removes only the document's resources. Other documents remain readable even when image content is identical. Released IDs may be reused.
No concurrency, deduplication optimization, RSS threshold, whole-platform parsing or protected-holdout claim is included.
